name: Burpee
summary: A full-body conditioning move that links a squat, plank and jump to raise the heart rate.
setup: Stand with feet shoulder width apart on a non-slip surface.
Clear space around you and use a mat if your hands slide.
execution: Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Jump or step your feet back into a straight-body plank.
Optionally lower your chest to the floor for a push-up.
Jump or step your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up explosively with arms overhead and land softly.
mistakes: Hips sagging in the plank: brace the abs and squeeze glutes.
Rounded back as you stand: keep the chest up when jumping in.
Stiff landing: bend the knees to absorb it.
Too fast, sloppy reps: step instead of jump, or skip the push-up.
